result.description: Compact 2-bay network archive appliance for small studios and labs, featuring dual 7,200 RPM enterprise-class drives in a mirrored configuration, 2.5GbE connectivity, and built-in snapshot management for long-term media retention. Designed for shared file access over LAN rather than direct-attached gaming or workstation workloads.
result.title: LumaForge Meridian M2 14TB Network Archive Appliance
